question: Should full `cluster` and `refresh` become unconditionally fail closed when configured vectors are missing or stale, even though existing workflows may stop after upgrade?
rationale: The stricter invariant improves correctness but intentionally removes an established permissive path and may require operator re-embedding before existing commands work.

options.title: Preserve compatibility by default
options.body: Keep existing full-run behavior as the default and expose strict complete-vector enforcement through an explicit option with tests and docs for both modes.

options.title: Approve fail-closed default
options.body: Accept the workflow break, document the re-embedding requirement prominently, and require existing-store upgrade smoke proof.

options.title: Split strict clustering
options.body: Land revision and summary storage separately and defer the default clustering policy change.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility by default
recommendation.body: Keep existing full-run behavior as the default and expose strict complete-vector enforcement through an explicit option with tests and docs for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history makes Peter the strongest owner for the existing refresh, vector, migration, and upgrade contract being changed.
